API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIAlertsGets the ongoing alert rules defined across an organization
Gets the ongoing alert rules defined across an organization
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/alerts/ongoing

Gets the ongoing alert rules defined across an organization. All ongoing alert rules are returned if the search filter is not specified. The endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours if not provided. Ongoing alerts are the alerts that don't have ended date. The alert started_on time in conjunction with provided filters will be used. Cannot exceed 14 days API limit.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

offset
string

The next_offset value from the last request. You must enter this value to get the next batch from the list. When the next_offset value becomes null, the list is complete.

limit
integer

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 10000

The number of items that must be returned per request from the list.

Default value: 1000
Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
alerts
object[]
next_offset
string

This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.
